summary: Tested Utility Contract Hub Expo/React Native app (3 screens: /signin, /dashboard, /scan) against LIVE external backend at https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass (login OK/wrong/missing, /me auth-gated, dashboard/overview, renewals/urgent, my/audits-in-progress all 200 with expected shape; test account has 0 contracts as expected). Frontend: signin validation (empty, invalid email) works with inline errors; wrong creds show 'Invalid credentials' error; valid login navigates to /dashboard; empty state (dashboard-empty) with 'Scan a bill' CTA renders correctly; scan primer shows scan-permission-primer with scan-enable-camera and scan-pick-gallery-primer; scan-back-button returns to /dashboard; token stored under key 'uch_auth_token'; root '/' correctly redirects unauthed users to /signin. All 12 captured API requests use the FULL external URL https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host/api/... (login, me, dashboard/overview, renewals/urgent, my/audits-in-progress). BUG: signout clears the token and user state (verified: localStorage token null, greeting becomes 'Hi, there') but does NOT navigate back to /signin — user is left visually on the dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking dashboard-signout-button clears the auth token and sets user=null, but the app remains on /dashboard instead of navigating to /signin. Greeting collapses to 'Hi, there' and the empty state still renders because dashboard.tsx does not watch the user state, and signOut() in auth-context.tsx does not call router.replace('/signin').

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on every render: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely originates from shadow.card in /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts (used in dashboard.tsx scanTile). Consider migrating to boxShadow for web / keep shadow* only for native platforms.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted after toast animation triggers; likely inside the toast component or a dependency.

Console warning: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web preview, but confirms Animated is used somewhere (probably toast) — informational only.

action_items: Fix signout navigation: in /app/frontend/app/dashboard.tsx, wrap signOut in a handler that also calls router.replace('/signin'), OR add a useEffect in dashboard.tsx that watches useAuth().user and redirects to /signin when it becomes null. Simpler: change the Pressable to onPress={async () => { await signOut(); router.replace('/signin'); }}.
Migrate shadow.card in /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts to use boxShadow for web (or gate shadow* usage to Platform.OS !== 'web') to remove the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth-context.tsx signOut() has no side-effect on navigation; either it should router.replace('/signin') itself, or every screen behind auth must redirect on user=null (currently only app/index.tsx does).
client.ts correctly builds API_URL = `${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api` and uses fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`) — verified all requests go to the full external URL.

dashboard.tsx: useFocusEffect + initial useEffect both call load() on mount, causing a duplicate fetch of dashboard/overview, renewals/urgent, my/audits-in-progress on first render (observed 2x back-to-back in network capture). Consider guarding useFocusEffect for first mount.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing test account e2e_test_1786703401@example.com from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is external and stable. Test account has 0 contracts by design (broker-gated), so empty state on dashboard is CORRECT. Only 3 screens are in scope (/signin, /dashboard, /scan). Scan camera capture / gallery picker cannot be exercised on the headless web preview — only the primer UI is testable. After main agent fixes the signout navigation, re-run the frontend playwright script and confirm URL goes to /signin after clicking dashboard-signout-button.
rca_of_issue:
BUG: Signout does not navigate.
Reproduction: 1) Login with test account, 2) On /dashboard tap dashboard-signout-button, 3) Observe URL still /dashboard, greeting shows 'Hi, there', localStorage key uch_auth_token = null.
Root cause: signOut() in /app/frontend/src/auth/auth-context.tsx only clears secure storage and resets user state. It does NOT trigger navigation. /app/frontend/app/dashboard.tsx does not observe user and does not redirect when user is null; only /app/frontend/app/index.tsx handles auth-based redirection.
Mitigation options (main agent to pick one):
  (a) In dashboard.tsx replace `onPress={signOut}` with `onPress={async () => { await signOut(); router.replace('/signin'); }}` — smallest change.
  (b) In auth-context.tsx's signOut, import router from expo-router and call router.replace('/signin') after clearing state — centralised fix.
  (c) Add a useEffect in dashboard.tsx: `useEffect(() => { if (!user) router.replace('/signin'); }, [user, router]);` — declarative, protects any future authed screen if pattern is reused.
